title_sq: Prane Pazarit Te Ri, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Me Hapesira Te Bollshme Dhe Planimetri Te Rregullt !!
description_sq: Prane Pazarit te Ri, Shitet Apartament 1+1, Hapesira Te Bollshme Dhe Planimetri Te Rregullt !! Apartamenti ndodhet ne katin e trete te nje pallati ekzistues 5 katesh. Apartamenti ka siperfaqe neto prej 65 m2 dhe organizohet nga korridori hyres, ambienti i ndenjes, me dalje ne ballkon, ambienti i gatimit me vete, nje dhome gjumi dhe tualeti me dritare. title_en: Near the New Market, 1+1 apartment for sale, with spacious spaces and a regular floor plan!!
description_en: Near the New Market, 1+1 Apartment for Sale, Ample Spaces and Regular Layout!! The apartment is located on the third floor of an existing 5-story building. The apartment has a net area of ​​65 m2 and is organized by the entrance corridor, the living room with access to the balcony, the kitchen, a bedroom and a bathroom with a window. The orientation is south-east, which means that there is natural light and sun throughout the day. It is also a very good opportunity both for housing and for investment, since the demands for long-term rent and daily rent are very high. The property has regular mortgage documentation.
